title: Temperature, Mass, and Turbulence: A Spatially Resolved Multiband Non-LTE Analysis of CS in TW Hya
question: What are the temperature, CS column density, H2 density and non-thermal broadening in the TW Hya disk, derived from three CS transitions, and what minimum disk mass do they imply?

evidence.quote: We use the collision rates from (cite: Denis-Alpizar_ea_2018)
The stellar mass was fixed at $0.65~M_{\rm sun}$ (cite: Qi_ea_2004)

what.value: Literature continuum fluxes for flux-scale check

evidence.quote: using flux measurements from (cite: Qi_ea_2004; Qi_ea_2006; Hughes_ea_2009; Tsukagoshi_ea_2016) and (cite: Zhang_ea_2016).

what.value: Surface density profiles compared with minimum-mass result

evidence.quote: we additionally plot surface density profiles from (cite: Gorti_ea_2011), used in (cite: Bergin_ea_2013) to model the HD flux

recipe.method: Provided scripts, phase self-cal, CLEAN with Keplerian mask, different weighting/taper per band to match beams
Fit Keplerian pattern to first moment maps
Shift each pixel by projected Keplerian velocity to common velocity, bin into 4 au annuli, average; fit Gaussian per annulus

recipe.goal: LTE fit of Tex and N(CS)
recipe.method: Rotation-diagram style fit of integrated fluxes with optical depth correction, pixel-by-pixel and on annuli
key_parameters: 256 walkers, 200 burn-in, 100 sampling steps; 10% flux systematic
assumptions: LTE; thermal broadening only for tau

recipe.method: Isothermal slab with RADEX grid (pyradex, 40 samples per axis, interpolated), sampled at fine resolution then Hanning smoothed; Gaussian-process noise
key_parameters: 13 free params per radius; 256 walkers, 1500 burn-in, 250 sampling steps
assumptions: Thermal H2 ortho-para ratio; slab geometry; no beam-smear correction

recipe.goal: Derive minimum gas surface density and disk mass
recipe.method: Convert minimum midplane n(H2) to Sigma_gas with Gaussian vertical structure and pressure scale height, integrate
assumptions: CS emission from <~1 H_mid; M*=0.65 Msun; mu in H_mid

evidence.quote: we find an average minimum disk mass of $3\times10^{-4}~M_{\rm sun}$
$T_{\rm kin} = 28$ K at 100 au compared to 12 K as in (cite: Teague_ea_2016)
Within the inner 30 au a constant temperature of $T_{\rm ex} \approx 40$ K is found, slowly dropping to 20 K at 200 au.
The binding energy of CS is 1900 K resulting in a desorption temperature of $T_{\rm desorb} \approx 31$ K

not_stated_but_needed: Keplerian mask parameters and clean thresholds/iterations
Robust value for Bands 4/7 (table says 2.0, text says natural) and exact Gaussian taper definitions
Line-free channels and continuum subtraction method
Self-calibration solution intervals and number of iterations
Initial walker positions and prior on line centres/noise parameters
Number of spws/execution blocks combined and pipeline version
score_reason: Public data and detailed fitting recipe, but imaging, self-cal and mask details are missing and no code is released.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results and a mostly complete recipe.
